Front page photo by Mark Shearman. It's a silver medal for 800 metre racer Tom Lerwill at the World Junior Championships in Sydney. Nineteen year-old Tom reduced his best ever time to 1:47.27 when chasing home the Kenyan Kimutai in his semi-final, and then in the final ran with great tactical awareness to work his way through the field, moving into second place in the home stretch.

Apart from his exploits in individual 800m events, Tom Lerwill had a part to play in two of our 4x400m records of 1996. In Istanbul he joined Ridgeon, Rawlinson and Nolan for a 3:09.30 clocking and pictured above, he anchored our under 20 squad to a 3:17.1 National Junior League record with a 47.6 effort.
